question: Out of the royal family that died, what kind of person was the one who was missed the most? I’d like to know their story. If a person who loved one of them got involved in the royal selection, I’d like to see that episode.
answer: The royals all had good personalities, if nothing else, so even though they lacked political ability, they were all more or less loved. King Randohal, who passed away, was often admonished by the council of wise men when he tried to carry out his ideas, but he was a good person who was trying to help the people of the kingdom. Historically, there was probably only one member of the Royal Family who died without being mourned.
